newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Marine shareholders approve B share issue.
newsitem.headline: China Marine shareholders approve B share issue.

text.p: Shareholders of China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd have agreed to plans to issue 48 million additional foreign currency B shares and $50 million worth of commercial paper, the company said on Monday.

The Shenzhen-listed company has yet to fix a date and offering price for the share issue, which will require the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, a company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
China Marine will use the proceeds to provide capital for future investment and production, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Shareholders have also agreed to issue $50 million in floating interest rate commercial paper, it said.
The company official said China Marine issued a similar amount of commercial paper in 1996, but declined to give details of the new issue.
China Marine posted net profits of 182.31 million yuan for 1996 against 138.9 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
The company's shareholders have also approved plans for a three-for-10 bonus share issue and a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the statement said.
China Marine has not yet determined the exchange rate for the cash dividend or the ex-dividend date, the official said.
Trading in the company's shares was suspended this morning for the announcement and will resume in the afternoon, the newspaper said.
